about.title: The firm
about.text: Nourra Holdings is an AI compute infrastructure company headquartered in Singapore. We build and operate data centres designed for GPU clusters, with engineering and operations carried out by our own teams.

items.name: Data centres
items.text: High-density facilities in and around Singapore, providing space, power and cooling for GPU clusters.

items.name: Engineering
items.text: Our own crews deliver electrical and low-voltage works, cabling, racking and facility conversion, and join larger projects as a specialist subcontractor.

items.name: Operations
items.text: On-site teams run day-to-day operations, inspections and fault response, delivered against a service level agreement.

items.name: Compute
items.text: Verified GPU capacity and enterprise cloud for our partners, deployed in our own facilities.

footprint.title: Footprint
footprint.lead: Based in Singapore, working across Southeast Asia.
